notes: The ratified cadence: build only the operator workflow the NEXT stage needs, once the PREVIOUS stage’s real outputs exist. Stop between stages and report.
Track 2 acceptance criterion 7 remains "met at the projection, per-stage wiring outstanding" — the honest reading of this candidate against the programme today.

canaries.assertion: `applyCandidateReviewDecision` refuses an ingesting decision with no `provenanceClass` before any write; the card reads `ingestion.ok` and renders an admitted-but-not-ingested source as the amber half-state it is.

statement: A programme stage is not executable until the operator path for it exists in the frontend and has been exercised against real data.

occurrences.defect: A workflow surface built ahead of its data is designed against an imagined shape of it: the Stage 8 assignment control asks the operator to type invariant IDs because there were no validated invariants to list when it was written. A stage with no inputs cannot be dry-run, so its refusals, empty states and error paths are all unverified — and a rendered stage reads as progress.

The queue posted `{decision, notes}` and never a `provenanceClass`; ingestion refused; the client read only the outer `ok`. Sources counted as admitted with zero evidence rows behind them — "safe read as finished", one stage earlier than expected and invisible.
